messages:
emma: Quick heads-up — starting calypso9b onboarding. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/calypso9b/v1/ (sharded). Can people sanity-check config/tokenizer before I request catalog entry? :eyes:

raj: Where exactly are the tokenizer files? I only see model_config.json and shard manifests in the bucket. Tokenizer.json + merges?

emma: tokenizer files are at s3://redwood-models/calypso9b/v1/tokenizer.json and tokenizer_vocab.txt. model_config.json is the root config — note it currently lists "max_positions": 4096.

chen: Quick note: tokenizer currently seems to assume add_prefix_space=true and has a handful of emoji/unicode tokens that blew up token counts in our smoke prompts. I'll run a tokenization diff on common prompts.

simran: Started a perf smoke on p4d-8x (single-worker) to get baseline. First numbers: batch=1 seq=512 95p latency ~240ms, throughput ~6.8k tok/s. With continuous batching (batch cap 8) we get ~28k tok/s but 95p spikes to ~520ms.

perf-bot: Perf job queued: https://perf.redwood/internal/jobs/987654 — logs -> s3://redwood-perf/calypso9b/smoke-987654. Config used: fp16, seq=512, batch_policy=max_batch_tokens:4096

raj: I saw an OOM on a 16GB test node when running seq=4096 -> looks like kv cache blew past memory. If model_config keeps max_positions=4096 we should either set default max_seq to 2048 in catalog or add split_kv=true for serving.

emma: Good catch. I'll open a tiny config patch to set "catalog_default_max_seq": 2048 and add a note in README. Pinging @chen to confirm tokenizer behavior before I change catalog.

chen: Confirmed tokenizer diffs: long-form prompts were getting ~1.6x tokens due to emoji and leading whitespace handling. Two actionable items: (1) set add_prefix_space=true in tokenizer.json, (2) add a small vocab prune to remove duplicate emoji entries. I can push those tomorrow morning.

simran: For perf tuning: if we can get stable batch=4-8 with max_latency_ms=60 policy we hit a sweet spot (throughput ~35-45k tok/s). But when sequence length distribution skews to 2k+, latency tails blow up. Suggest catalog variants: calypso9b (default fp16, max_seq 2048) + calypso9b-long (fp16, max_seq 4096, reserved capacity).

emma: Sounds good. Also thinking about quant variants — should we include an int8 candidate in the catalog for cost testing? @perf-bot please kick an int8 smoke once tokenizer/config are updated. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: INT8 smoke job queued: https://perf.redwood/internal/jobs/987659. Note: INT8 run uses quant-profile: dynamic-range, test-iters=300.

ci-bot: CI: model upload manifest validated (checksums OK). One lint warning in model_config.json (unused "training_params" key) — not blocking.

raj: OK — once chen pushes tokenizer fixes I will re-run a full perf sweep (seq buckets: 128/512/1024/2048) and update catalog metadata (default batch policy + tail_lat_warning).

emma: Thanks all — moving to async. I'll create the catalog PR after the int8 smoke finishes and we have the final perf numbers. Happy to triage any follow-ups in here. :sparkles:
